I'll include model_family with models [{"model_id": "TD52P"}, {"model_id": "TD52XW"}] — actually, is TD52XW vs TD52P different models? Yes, two type designations. I'll include them.

Actually let me be careful — the rules say model_level entries only when attributes vary per model. Since characteristics are listed once (not per type), they're type_level. I'll keep characteristics in type_level and include model_family.models with the two type IDs.
